'''''Star Wars: Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire''''' is a miniseries of comics in the [[Star Wars: Boba Fett (comic series)|''Boba Fett'' series]] written by [[John Wagner]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] from [[January 27]] to [[April 28]], [[1999]].
